{{Quote|Mighty hunter! You killed terrible beasts from Hutta and beyond&mdash;and the beast master too!|Nem'ro congratulates the bounty hunter for slaying Fleshripper and the others|translated=1|audio=Nemro-KilledBeasts.flac|<ref name="House Cleaning" />}}
'''Fleshripper''', known as '''the Unkillable''', was a [[skinflayer]] [[Nem'ro's gang|owned]] by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Suudaa Nem'ro]]. The creature was kept in a pit within the Hutt's [[Nem'ro's Palace|palace]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], where it was cared for by the crime lord's [[Suudaa Nem'ro's beast master|beast master]].<ref name="House Cleaning" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Dates" /> Nem'ro sent a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the supposedly treacherous beast master as part of a series of tests to prove that the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|hunter]] was worthy of Nem'ro's sponsorship in the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]] competition.<ref name="House Cleaning" />

Having been warned that the hunter was coming, the beast master prepared Fleshripper and several other creatures in cages around the pit, releasing them in waves once the bounty hunter arrived. As Nem'ro watched, the hunter killed two waves of creatures before the beast master released Fleshripper and two young [[Vrblther/Legends|vrblthers]]. The bounty hunter killed all three creatures and then the beast master [[Gender/Legends|himself]], earning congratulations from Nem'ro. Fleshripper had [[Color/Legends|brown]] skin and black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="House Cleaning" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fleshripper appeared as a non-optional enemy in "House Cleaning," a quest in the bounty hunter class campaign in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|massively-multiplayer online roleplaying game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="House Cleaning" />
